title: Nodes
description: Resources across socrat-0/1/2/3: CPU, load, memory, disks, and network. All metrics come from node-exporter.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since each selected node last booted, evaluated at the end of the selected time range. A drop indicates a reboot or a change in the reported boot time; this is host uptime, not container uptime.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((time() - node_boot_time_seconds{job="node-exporter"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Logical CPU cores
panels.description: Number of logical CPU cores exposed to the operating system on each selected node at the end of the selected time range. Includes hardware threads and virtual CPUs; this is capacity, not current utilization.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((count by(instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Physical memory
panels.description: Total RAM reported by the operating system on each selected node at the end of the selected time range. Displayed in byte-based units; this is total memory, not free memory or GPU memory.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: CPU utilization
panels.description: Non-idle CPU time as a percentage of all logical CPU capacity, averaged over the automatic rate interval. Includes I/O wait. Near 100% means little idle CPU time remains; it does not distinguish computation from waiting for I/O.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((100 * (1 - avg by(instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Load average per core
panels.description: Five-minute load average divided by the number of logical CPU cores. A value of 1 means an average of one runnable or uninterruptibly waiting task per core. Sustained values above 1 can indicate contention, but disk I/O waits also contribute; this is not CPU utilization.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((node_load5{job="node-exporter"} / on(instance) count by(instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Load average · 1 / 5 / 15 minutes
panels.description: Average number of runnable tasks and tasks in uninterruptible sleep, including disk I/O wait, over 1, 5 and 15 minutes. Compare with logical CPU core count to assess demand. These fixed averaging windows do not change with the dashboard time range.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((node_load1{job="node-exporter"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))
avg by (nodename) ((node_load5{job="node-exporter"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))
avg by (nodename) ((node_load15{job="node-exporter"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Memory utilization
panels.description: Percentage of RAM not available for new applications: total memory minus the kernel estimate of available memory. Reclaimable cache is accounted for. A rising percentage means less memory headroom.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Available memory
panels.description: RAM the kernel estimates can be used by new applications without swapping, including reclaimable cache, in byte-based units. A falling value means less memory headroom.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Swap used
panels.description: Swap space currently used, in byte-based units. Zero may mean swap is unused or disabled. This measures stored pages, not the rate at which pages are being swapped.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"} - node_memory_SwapFree_bytes{job="node-exporter"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Root filesystem · used
panels.description: Percentage of the root filesystem unavailable to ordinary processes, including used space and filesystem reservations. Near 100% means little writable space remains; other mount points are not included.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter",mountpoint="/",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter",mountpoint="/",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs"})) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Root filesystem · available
panels.description: Free root-filesystem space available to ordinary processes, in byte-based units. Filesystem reservations are excluded. A falling value means less room for application data, images and logs on this filesystem.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename) ((node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter",mountpoint="/",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay|squashfs"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Read and write throughput per disk device, in bytes per second averaged over the automatic rate interval. Physical and logical devices are shown separately and should not be added together. Loop, RAM and optical devices are excluded.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename, device) ((rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{job="node-exporter",device!~"loop.*|ram.*|sr.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

avg by (nodename, device) ((rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="node-exporter",device!~"loop.*|ram.*|sr.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Inbound traffic
panels.description: Received traffic per network interface, in bytes per second averaged over the automatic rate interval. Includes WireGuard; container and loopback interfaces are excluded. Tunnel traffic may also cross a physical interface, so adding both can double-count it.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename, device) ((rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{job="node-exporter",device!~"lo|veth.*|cali.*|cni.*|flannel.*|docker.*|br-.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Outbound traffic
panels.description: Transmitted traffic per network interface, in bytes per second averaged over the automatic rate interval. Includes WireGuard; container and loopback interfaces are excluded. Tunnel traffic may also cross a physical interface, so adding both can double-count it.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename, device) ((rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="node-exporter",device!~"lo|veth.*|cali.*|cni.*|flannel.*|docker.*|br-.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Network interface errors
panels.description: Receive and transmit errors per second on each network interface, averaged over the automatic rate interval. Nonzero values warrant checking that interface. This does not directly measure end-to-end packet loss or internet availability.

targets.expr: avg by (nodename, device) ((rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{job="node-exporter",device!~"lo|veth.*|cali.*|cni.*|flannel.*|docker.*|br-.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

avg by (nodename, device) ((rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{job="node-exporter",device!~"lo|veth.*|cali.*|cni.*|flannel.*|docker.*|br-.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Maximum sensor temperature
panels.description: Highest reported hardware sensor temperature on each node, in degrees Celsius. Includes CPU and storage sensors, so the hottest device can change over time. The socrat-2 VPS exposes no sensors and has no series; missing data does not mean a temperature of zero.

targets.expr: max by(nodename) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{job="node-exporter"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{job="node-exporter",nodename=~"$node"}))
